start: ^The ancient e-ink screen flickers to life.
^A single line of text materializes, letter by letter.
^Examine the strange device in your hands
forest: ^The trees close in around you. Dappled light filters through leaves that haven't changed in centuries.

c-0: ^The left fork leads to a clearing. In the center, an old stone well.
c-1: ^The right fork is overgrown. You push through brambles until you reach a moss-covered ruin.

river: ^The river runs clear and cold. Smooth stones line the banks.

c-0: ^Your fingers close around a small brass key. As you lift it, the water whispers your new name.
c-1: ^You walk for what feels like hours. The river widens into a delta.

examine_device: ^You turn the device over in your hands. It's impossibly thin.
^A screen of electronic paper. Six buttons. No touchscreen.
^It feels like holding a piece of the future.
^"This is your story," the screen reads. "Every choice matters."

c-0: ^The screen clears. A new chapter begins.
^You wait. And wait. No splash ever comes.
^"Some depths have no bottom," the screen observes.

ruins: ^The ruins whisper of a civilization that read only on paper.
^A single book remains on a crumbling shelf.

c-0: ^The pages are blank. But as you watch, text appears:

key_found: ^The brass key feels warm in your palm. But there is no lock in sight.

c-0: ^You pocket the key. Perhaps its purpose will reveal itself.
c-1: ^The river accepts the key silently. The glinting stops.

lighthouse: ^The lighthouse stands alone against the grey sky.
^Its light has been dark for years.

c-0: ^From the top, you can see the entire world—forest, river, ruins, and beyond.
^The e-ink screen renders it all in perfect monochrome.
c-1: ^The last entry reads: "The reader has arrived."
